content:
sam_customer: Hey team — saw a sudden billing spike and duplicate downstream actions after our client deploy at ~10:05 UTC. This looks like tool/function calls executed twice. Full repro below, please escalate.

alice_support: digging in. Can you paste the raw request payload + headers and any API request_id?

sam_customer: request_id=rid_3b9f. Client is a small Go lambda that wraps our payment API; we updated string handling for non-ascii chars. Payload we send:
```json
{
  "order_id": "ord-42",
  "note": "Café — deliver ASAP"
}
```
headers: `Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8`

sam_customer: Server logs show a 400 schema validation the first attempt then a 202 accepted and execution again: looks like client retried on 400 then got accepted on second try, but function executed both times (side-effect idempotency not honored).

alice_support: we see rid_3b9f in our edge logs. Sequence: POST -> 400 (schema validation: malformed JSON) -> client retry -> POST -> 202 accepted -> job executed. But how did the job run for the first 400? need to check tool-call parsing layer.

raj_engineer: poking at our fncall pipeline. Quick hypothesis: client double-encoded the body (percent-encoded UTF-8 in the JSON string) which passed HTTP parser but failed our JSON schema at validation stage, yet a downstream fallback deserializer coerced it and triggered tool execution before the validator aborted. That's a bug. Can you share raw bytes from inbound?

sam_customer: raw bytes (hex): `7b226f726465725f6964223a226f72642d3432222c226e6f7465223a2243c3a920e28094c6161746520e28093` (ugh)

raj_engineer: thanks. Looks like our edge accepted `Content-Type` and queued a work item before schema validation completed. Then schema validator returned 400, client retried, edge accepted second time and processed. We should never queue work until schema pass.

maria_sre: @raj_engineer can you confirm whether this ordering change coincided with the runtime patch last week? We had an optimization that moved parsing downstream to speed up the router.

raj_engineer: yes, patch id=p2026-utf8-opt moved JSON deserialization off the main thread and into the worker pool; it now acknowledges earlier. Race: ACK occurs before schema validation. Bad: ack makes client think it failed and retry semantics cause double exec.

alice_support: immediate mitigation for customers: 1) we can reject earlier (edge) when content-type/charset mismatch, 2) enable strict-at-edge schema validation toggle for affected tenants. Can SRE enable a temporary toggle?

maria_sre: enabling `strict_schema_at_edge` for tenant sam_corp now. deploy_bot: toggling flag...
deploy_bot: feature-flag update succeeded for tenant sam_corp (ff:strict_schema_at_edge=true)

sam_customer: thanks — billing spikes subsided after toggle. What are next permanent fixes?

raj_engineer: action items: (A) revert premature ack behavior so we only ack after schema validation passes, (B) add defensive idempotency on tool execution layer (idempotency keys for tool calls), (C) add a regression test with multi-encoding payloads (UTF-8 plus percent-encoded) to prevent double-exec. I'll open PRs.

alice_support: can you include a short repro script we can run in Support to validate before/after? That will help customers replicate safely.

raj_engineer: pasted a small curl repro:
```bash
# bad client double-encoding example
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.local/v1/invoke \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8" \n  --data-binary $'{"order_id":"ord-42","note":"Caf%C3%A9 - deliver ASAP"}'
```
This simulates a client that percent-encoded the UTF-8 bytes inside the JSON string literal.

alice_support: perfect. I'll attach to the support ticket and share the mitigation steps we applied.

maria_sre: long-term schedule: rollback the `p2026-utf8-opt` or patch ordering in next hotfix (priority P1). Also please add telemetry: metric for # of acks-before-validation occurrences per tenant.

raj_engineer: opened issues: RWF-512 (ack ordering bug), RWF-513 (toolcall idempotency), RWF-514 (encoding regression tests). Linking PRs: https://git.redwood/r/2345 (WIP).

sam_customer: appreciate fast response. Please confirm when the codefix lands and if you can credit the incidental charges for the duplicate executions — our billing team will follow up.

alice_support: we can offer a billing credit for the spike; marking ticket as escalated to Billing Ops. Tagging @billing_team.

deploy_bot: hotfix patch p2026-utf8-opt.patch applied to canary. Canary results: 0 acks-before-validation events after patch.

raj_engineer: merging fix to main after CI. Expected full rollout tonight. Will post commit and migration notes.

alice_support: closing loop here once rollout completes and billing credit confirmed. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
